content: {"rule":"K-G4","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text addresses whether the pressed Jeremiah 22:30 verse affects the link and treats it as not counting because the relevant limb was dropped.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"D6 vs C4 (Jeremiah 22:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.","rule_words":"A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count. A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way. If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it.
